sentences.text: 2 Today, when the matter is taken up for hearing, it is reported that the writ petitioner died on 17.09.2022 itself.

2. The learned counsel for the 9th respondent submitted that the matter is related to land acquisition and now the matter is pending with the Acquisition Tribunal regarding disbursement of compensation.
3.

In view of the fact that the sole writ petitioner died on 17.09.2022 itself and so far, the legal representatives of the deceased have not taken any steps to implead themselves and to prosecute this writ petition, the Writ Petition is dismissed as abated.
Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petitions are closed.
There shall be no order as to the costs.
